context: Your rules say approval comes only from a message you typed. A saved answer on a page is a new kind of approval, so it needs a rule. This page is private to your account, so only you can save to it.

options.gain: Answers work without a paste. The page does its job.
options.how: A session treats a saved answer here exactly like your typed reply.
options.label: Yes, for your own save on a page only you can write

options.how: The page builds a text block that you paste into a thread.
options.label: No, only a typed message counts
options.lose: A copy and paste every time.

ref: o10 (a page per session for questions), choice 3
title: An answer you save on this page counts as your word
why: Without it, this page is only a reading aid. The page is private, so the save can only be yours.
